captions.detailed: A classic pedestal-mounted gumball vending machine featuring a red base, a cylindrical metal stand, and a red rectangular mechanism housing. On top sits a spherical transparent glass bowl filled with colorful gumballs, crowned by a hinged red refill lid. The dispensing mechanism on the front consists of a grey rectangular faceplate, a rotating turn-handle on a horizontal shaft, and a small hinged flap door at the bottom chute for retrieving candy.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a classic pedestal gumball vending machine. The model should include a bottom pedestal base with a vertical support post, a rectangular mechanism housing with a rotating crank handle, a transparent spherical bowl filled with small colored spheres, a hinged top refill lid, and a hinged flap door at the bottom dispensing chute.
captions.factory: Construct the base pedestal using a flat cylinder and a vertical cylindrical support post. Build the main rectangular housing using a box with filleted vertical edges, and hollow out the front face to attach a thin faceplate. Create the turn-handle assembly using a cylinder for the shaft and a custom-shaped handle. Model the gumball bowl with a sphere, subtracting a concentric inner sphere to give it wall thickness, and populate the interior with several small colored spheres. Top the bowl with a stepped cylindrical lid and a small hinge block. Assemble all parts as an articulated model, defining revolute joints for the top refill lid, the continuous rotation of the crank handle, and the lower dispenser flap door.
